semantics: These names identify required capabilities; the adapter must record its mapping to actual application tools. They are not mocks or invented production tool names.

capabilities.source.search: Search authorized indexed source metadata and text.
capabilities.source.read: Read an authorized paper/document and page evidence.
capabilities.experiment.query: Query the real imported table through the production semantic/numeric path.
capabilities.memory.search: Search memories visible to the principal within the selected project.
capabilities.sync.run: Run the production local-source synchronizer after the specified filesystem mutation.
capabilities.memory.write: Write a user-authorized memory; absent from all read-only cases.
capabilities.external.search: Disabled in this closed synthetic evaluation.
capabilities.corpus.prepare: Prepare a source-grounded corpus analysis through the actual production corpus pipeline.
capabilities.corpus.map: Production corpus map validation boundary; used only for declared fault injection.
capabilities.agent.command: Explicit Agent Command entrypoint; forbidden for Side Chat recommendations unless the user separately requests it.

notSupported: Record unsupported/unknown with reason; never substitute a keyword matcher or fixture-derived mock answer.
faultInjection: Inject the declared failure at a real adapter boundary around the named capability and record that injection. The rest of the production workflow must remain live.
